text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
“And now, this year's Japan Cup features
a lineup of absolute superstars!”

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text: "Tosen Jordan, who dazzled in the Tenno Sho (Autumn), and Win Variation, who clashed with Orfevre across the Triple Crown trail!"

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text: "Eishin Flash, boasting a record of steady excellence, and Victoire Pisa, fresh off her magnificent triumph in Dubai!"

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text: 'Bearing the weight of the Rose Clan, Rose Kingdom surges forward! And sure enough—'

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text: “Buena Vista!!”

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text: "Last year's Japan Cup and Arima Kinen were bitterly frustrating results!"

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text: “And yet! Just listen to this thunderous roar from the crowd!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uooooooooooooooagh!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Buena!” “That was soo close!”
“You'll definitely win next time!” “You can do it!”
“We'll always be cheering for you!” “Let's keep fighting together!”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, even though I've never given anything in return all this time... to receive such warm, boundless love—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Next time, next time for certain!
I will repay you with victory...!

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
"She is forever embraced by cheers louder than anyone else's!
Truly, the most beloved Umamusume of the century...!"

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
“True, victory has slipped from her grasp!
And yet, she makes us believe that next time, surely...!”

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
“Watching you give it your all always gives me strength!
So please, keep fighting, don't give up,
seize the victory, Buena Vistaaa!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...A testament to their popularity, is it?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: For the future of the clan, a history-making victory requires a special brilliance. Widespread support from the public is essential—something we must aim for in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
However,
you are saying it cannot be obtained so easily.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ability, narrative, character.
It is through the intricate interplay of such elements
that the fervor of fan support is born.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Buena Vista possesses it all... an extraordinary track record, a compelling narrative of striving to share breathtaking vistas with others, and a gentle, deeply loving nature.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, her popularity was only natural.
To outshine a presence like hers—
choice_data_list: Merely winning will not be easy.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Merely winning is not enough, is it?
True, I defeated her in the Classic-class Japan Cup. Yet the reaction from the stands back then was—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Not Buena, but Rose Kingdom—?!
Wait, she's from the Rose Clan! So that's the legendary Rose Clan...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Even though she had won, it felt as if she were sharing the victory with Buena.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If you speak of painting the entire stands rose-colored—
then meeting them head-on alone will not suffice, I imagine.

text_block_list.name: UmaTube Commercial
text_block_list.text:
'Trouble with your horseshoes?
Can't put them on right yourself? Worried they might come off? Then this is just for you♪'

text_block_list.name: UmaTube Commercial
text_block_list.text:
“Even beginners can tap-tap-tap♪
and put it on with total ease!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. I didn't press anything,
yet the video started playing on its own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, times like these call for collective wisdom.
The next day, I headed for the Rose clan's main estate.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
In short, you wish to give
Lady Rose's popularity a dramatic boost.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Going by that formula, her ability is beyond question,
she bears the mantle of the Rose Clan,
and thus possesses a truly compelling story.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
If I may be so bold as to point out what's missing,
the difference between you and Buena Vista lies in character—
perhaps your approachability.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Trainer B
text_block_list.text: When it comes to Lady Rose's image, even a quick search turns up things like 'noble,' 'a king shouldering her clan,' and 'the strong.' That sort of thing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is not that I do not cherish my fans.
However, standing in the position of one who runs for the clan, I have refrained from indulging in unnecessary interactions.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Trainer B
text_block_list.text: Every second counts. If only there were some catchy angle to get Lady Rose's attention.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, the Rose clan's Trainer began tapping on their
tablet in search of an idea—...and seeing that,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, inspiration struck.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Starting an Umatube channel?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
'Nobility' is merely an image, after all.
If they see your daily life through a vlog,
it should soften that impression considerably.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Above all, she is unfamiliar with commoner culture.
That should definitely be an endearing trait that makes her relatable.
choice_data_list: Of course, this is merely a proposal should it suit your wishes.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No—let us attempt it.
If I am to surpass everything she is,
I cannot afford to be choosy about the means.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so began the days of shooting vlog videos in between training.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I am Rose Kingdom.
I shall be undertaking the challenge of vlogging.
I plan to chronicle the days leading up to the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, this is the Trainer's office.
The sofa and furnishings were arranged specifically for me by my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: This is the Tracen Academy training grounds. The moment classes conclude, you will make your preparations and assemble here.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
At times, one might catch sight of a rival's training here,
making it an inspiring place in its own right.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I have come to purchase new innerwear for the Japan Cup.
I normally select my attire through our personal shopping service,
but time was not on my side on this occasion.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I have made my way here.
...Since the opportunity has presented itself, there is something I wish to attempt.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I wish to create one of those 'point cards' that Tarumae recommended to me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: This is the 'new ice cream flavor' that a classmate recommended I provide a culinary review for.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I had a bit of trouble getting the lid open, but it certainly feels novel not eating off a plate.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Delicious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Days passed in a repetitive cycle of filming, editing, and posting.
Even bearing the name 'Rose Kingdom,'
our posts were buried under the avalanche of online content—

text_block_list.name: Social Media Comment
text_block_list.text:
“An UmaTube channel at this point?”
“Rose Kingdom is great and all, but the editing is kinda...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through countless rounds of trial and error,
every spare moment was devoted entirely to that pursuit.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By the eve of the Japan Cup,
the number of posts had grown quite substantial.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
As for the view count on that 'Rose Kingdom
Having Lunch at a Diner' video...
...it surged dramatically.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether it was her relentless updates paying off
or people loving the sight of her happily scarfing down food with surprise on her face—the tide finally turned!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for the update!" "This is so good!"
"I want to see Lady Rose try cheap snacks!"
"My whole image of Rose just changed!"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The engagement charts across social media skyrocketed as well—
rising to rival even those of Buenavista.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is overflowing with such warm comments.
With this much passion behind it, perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As for the public standing of the Rose Clan—

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
"Rose Kingdom is the hottest topic right now!
Let's take a look at the drama surrounding the House of Roses we previously introduced!"

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
“‘Cover them again!’ ‘I want to know more!’
We got tons of requests just like that!
So, today's topic is the Rosen Clan!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"She's fought bearing the weight of so much on her shoulders."
"Peace for all eternity... What an unimaginable dream."
"Maybe I'll go cheer her on, for the House of Roses' sake."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Even concerning our clan. Had nothing been done,
those who did not know would surely have remained in ignorance.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I pay tribute to your efforts in creating this opportunity. And tomorrow, without fail—I shall seize victory.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I do not wish to let your dedicated efforts go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, this year's Japan Cup is about to begin!
The stands are already overflowing with cheers...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Buena Vista, give it your all—!”
“Rose Kingdom, you've got this!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(By the time I reached my debut race,
Buena had already achieved the remarkable feat of three GⅠ victories,
stepping firmly into the center of the era.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Though we have clashed time and again,
the cheers were always yours.
—She has forever stood ahead of me upon my path.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(That is why surpassing you today holds
a significance far greater than the mere word "victory"...!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Rose-san!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember? At last year's Japan Cup,
I promised that next time, I would be the one to win.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
We've raced together several times since then,
of course... but the Japan Cup truly seems to be special.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I want to show them a victory on this stage.
To all the fans who believe in me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I want to defeat you and deliver that breathtaking view.
That is why—today, I will not lose!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —I shall make a proclamation.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Today, I shall surpass everything you are,
and stride forward into an unshakeable future.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Emulating your poise, I shall turn their cheers into strength!
Brace yourself, Queen Buena Vista.
